comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: The spec-review loop has reached its stop signal for this amendment: round 22 clean (UX, narrowed with declared standing reason; SA and A11y clean since round 6, AIE clean at rounds 7 and 8). Twenty-two rounds, filed series 15-16-11-6-8-2-2-2-1-2-1-2-2-3-3-2-3-3-2-2-1-2-0. The amendment that began as a bootstrap shell script now contracts: the three-form rendering with one snapshot acquisition and a pure segment renderer; the never-silent principle across absence, degradation, truncation, and unreadable state on every surface; the degraded and read-failure kinds with per-kind recovery on both human and machine forms; the install offer with drift-refusal, read-modify-write preservation, accept-flag conduct, full read- and write-failure discipline, and the six-member wiring-outcome enumeration closing the automation trace; count-based instruments throughout (stdin, acquisition, wall-clock, model-absence); and the accessible-equivalent guarantee discharged by a real AT pass. Every finding fixed with revision evidence and closed. The amendment stands at revision 22. Awaiting operator ratification — the loop's exit is the operator's act.
